items.q: What is the functional group of propan-1-ol?
items.qAf: Wat is die funksionele groep van propan-1-ol?
items.explain: The –OH group on a carbon chain identifies an alcohol.

items.q: What is the IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃?
items.qAf: Wat is die IUPAC-naam van CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃?
items.explain: The longest chain has 4 carbons (butane) with a methyl group on carbon 2. Counting from the end that gives the lowest number: 2-methylbutane.
items.explainAf: Die langste ketting het 4 koolstowwe (butaan) met ’n metielgroep op koolstof 2. Tel vanaf die kant wat die laagste nommer gee: 2-metielbutaan.

items.q: What is the IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂COOCH₃?
items.qAf: Wat is die IUPAC-naam van CH₃CH₂COOCH₃?
items.explain: It is an ester: the alkyl part is methyl (from methanol) and the acid part is propanoate (3 carbons).
items.explainAf: Dit is ’n ester: die alkieldeel is metiel (van metanol) en die suurdeel is propanoaat (3 koolstowwe).

items.q: Consecutive members of a homologous series differ by:
items.qAf: Opeenvolgende lede van ’n homoloë reeks verskil deur:
items.explain: Each member is one –CH₂– unit larger than the one before.
items.explainAf: Elke lid is een –CH₂–-eenheid groter as die een voor dit.

items.explain: Same molecular formula C₅H₁₂ with different carbon-chain branching: chain isomers. The other pairs differ in functional group or position of a group.
items.explainAf: Dieselfde molekulêre formule C₅H₁₂ met verskillende vertakking van die koolstofketting: ketting-isomere. Die ander pare verskil in funksionele groep of posisie van ’n groep.

items.q: Which compound has the highest boiling point: pentane, 2-methylbutane or 2,2-dimethylpropane?
items.qAf: Watter verbinding het die hoogste kookpunt: pentaan, 2-metielbutaan of 2,2-dimetielpropaan?
items.explain: All three are alkanes with the same London forces. More branching gives a smaller surface area and weaker forces, so the unbranched pentane boils highest.
items.explainAf: Almal drie is alkane met dieselfde Londonkragte. Meer vertakking gee ’n kleiner oppervlak en swakker kragte, dus kook die onvertakte pentaan die hoogste.

items.q: Compounds with the same molecular formula but different structural formulae.
items.qAf: Verbindings met dieselfde molekulêre formule maar verskillende struktuurformules.

items.q: A series of organic compounds with the same functional group, each differing by CH₂.
items.qAf: ’n Reeks organiese verbindings met dieselfde funksionele groep, wat elk met CH₂ verskil.

items.q: A hydrocarbon that contains only single bonds between carbon atoms.
items.qAf: ’n Koolwaterstof wat net enkelbindings tussen koolstofatome bevat.

items.q: The functional group of an alcohol.

items.text: Alkenes contain a carbon–carbon [[]] bond, and their general formula is [[]].
items.textAf: Alkene bevat ’n koolstof-koolstof-[[]]binding, en hul algemene formule is [[]].

items.explain: True. Both are C₄H₁₀ but with different carbon chains.
items.explainAf: Waar. Albei is C₄H₁₀ maar met verskillende koolstofkettings.

items.q: The functional group of carboxylic acids is the carbonyl group alone.
items.qAf: Die funksionele groep van karboksielsure is die karbonielgroep alleen.
items.explain: False. It is the carboxyl group (–COOH).

items.q: Match each homologous series in column A with its functional group in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke homoloë reeks in kolom A by sy funksionele groep in kolom B.
